question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**act**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes a situation where a driver is pulling up horses near a ruined castle, suggesting an action being performed in the process.
 
• The appropriate noun should reflect an action, as the driver is engaged in the process of stopping or pulling up the horses.
 
• **Act** fits well here as it refers to an action or process being carried out, which aligns with the context of pulling up the horses.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Theatre (नाट्य): "Theatre" refers to a building or activity associated with plays or performances, which does not fit the context of the passage.
 
• Play (नाटक): "Play" refers to a performance or drama, which is unrelated to the action of stopping or pulling up horses in the passage.
 
• Drama (नाटक): "Drama" refers to a serious or emotional story performed on stage, which does not align with the description of the driver's action in the passage.
